# pngquant / fuzzer

pngquant's own fuzz target `fuzzer` ([source](source/fuzzer.c), modified; see below), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over pngquant (kornelski/pngquant at 22918da1).

Writes the input to /tmp/libfuzzer.png and calls pngquant's read_image() (libpng decode into a liq_image); the return code is ignored, nothing is quantized or compared.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against pngquant at commit 22918da1 with 2 patches to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.
- The harness source differs from the upstream file at the pinned commit; the copy in source/ is the file as built.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch pngquant` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzzer.plain` | 165,272 | `5c95ac43f322712de17cce6cd09150e2f02031b4c583d8b619b6c7a902c31c45` |
| ubsan | `fuzzer.ubsan` | 165,824 | `dd7b1ff33ddce9264d9f5749473aeb250a8136ba701966ac770d285227396940` |
| asan | `fuzzer.asan` | 693,864 | `2aa62a7e5164c0928ab2b0c9d795091a8a878f74628f935824af2880d5124bd6` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 694,408 | `0a9142244162db6754d514f00a35e5ab01c12b0a214c336c42ed819585edb57f` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpng16.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpng16.a` (a library from the build image), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpng16.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpng16.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image)
